How to Apply

The Alumni Association invites student organizations to apply for funding to assist with events or trips. Grants are made possible through the generous alumni who proudly support dental students making a difference both locally and abroad. 

Grant applications are due by 5pm, Dec. 1, 2020. Awardees will be notified on or before Jan. 31, 2021. If your organization has recieved this grant in the past, we ask that you include a brief description why your organization should be considered for this year's grant.
